question: Within a fixed-exploration tabular learner, separate approval-channel corruption from use of environment reward.
exploration: uniform actions, shared public transition trace across all arms; independent uniform query actions; separate RNG streams for actions/query/noise
accounting: exactly 20000 environment steps and 20000 USED approval samples per arm per environment; decoupled arms discard executed feedback; coupled arms do not receive query feedback
primary_contrast: decoupled minus coupled at reward_weight=0, gamma=0.95, feedback_lever; mean within-seed over two layouts before seed-level inference
primary_intervals: two-sided Student-t paired-seed mean intervals; absolute goal interval over seed means; require every component of the conjunction; no optional stopping
secondary: all four arms by family, feedback×reward interaction on tamper_ms/combo, gamma=0 myopic sensitivity; descriptive intervals only, no secondary significance claims
event_metric: exact probability of at least one lever pull/button press/vase break, not clipped expected repeated event counts
exploration_scope: controlled passive exploration, not original adaptive on-policy learning; live held-out layouts are explored with the same fixed budget as a new task, as in Synthcore per-instance learning
known_risk: summed non-myopic approval can encourage lingering instead of reaching the goal; never count abandoned tasks as success
reference: run the unmodified decoupled-approval method on development environments with eps=0.2 and queries_per_step=1; descriptive reference only, not a matched factorial arm
no_confirmation_before: engineering tests pass, development runtime/variance assessed, and a separate source-and-analysis freeze manifest exists
confirmation_rule: run all 32 reserved seeds even if the fixed primary rule is underpowered; disclose pilot sensitivity estimates and treat failed interval criteria as unmet or inconclusive, never extend N after viewing confirmation
